title: Correct a₁ value
description: Essential: The answer must state a₁ = 10 m/s², derived from the slope of the v² vs. x graph for 0–3.2 m.

title: Correct a₂ value
description: Essential: The answer must state a₂ = 2 m/s², derived from the slope of the v² vs. x graph for 3.2–12.2 m.

title: Correct μ value
description: Essential: The answer must state the coefficient of kinetic friction μ = 0.5, obtained from applying Newton's second law to both motion phases.

title: Graph interpretation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the kinematic relation v² = v₀² + 2aΔx to interpret the slopes in Figure B.

title: Newton's second law setup
description: Important: The solution must set up force equations for both acceleration phases, considering gravity, normal force, and kinetic friction along the incline.

title: Simultaneous equation solving
description: Important: The solution must solve the two force equations simultaneously to eliminate unknowns like the incline angle and find μ.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All final answers should include correct SI units (m/s² for accelerations, dimensionless for μ).

title: Sign error in friction direction
description: Pitfall: Penalize if friction direction is incorrectly assigned relative to the belt's motion or the slider's velocity, leading to wrong force equations.

title: Misreading graph slopes
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the acceleration is calculated from v vs. x instead of v² vs. x, or if the graph segments are misidentified.
